decisions.reason: Configuring the contract-event webhook does not change any required FAQ content or messaging.
The webhook configuration does not change the required NFT metadata counters or metadata-accuracy behavior.
The webhook decision does not alter the landing-page hero wording or emphasized selling points.
The backend webhook configuration is unrelated to the required hero layout, sizing, and image placement.
Capturing contract logs does not resolve or change whether prizes are transferred automatically or exposed through a conditional claim interaction.
The webhook targets the active contract, but the source does not change the dashboard ownership-display rule or contract-visibility requirement.
The webhook may receive prize-related logs, but it does not change Chainlink VRF selection, eligibility, weighting, or verification rules.
The webhook setup is unrelated to Blockaid verification and remediation of the wallet-security false positive.
Although the webhook captures referral and ticket logs, its configuration does not change the no-code reward package, recipient selection, or first-mint exception.
Capturing all logs from the contract does not change the required royalty amount, ERC-721C standard, or marketplace controls.
The webhook can observe referral events but does not change the $5 commission or one-ticket coded-referral reward.
The webhook configuration does not modify the mint price, founder share, referral commission, or prize-pool allocation.
